title: Love this app
body:
It’s simple and easy to use.
I’d love support for habits focused on reducing behaviors (like food delivery), not just completing tasks.
It would also be great to set habits for weekdays or weekends only.
Already a great app, and these would make it even better!
author: Newbee026

title: really love the app
body: I really love the app! Thank you so much for creating it. It would be great if users could have more color options to choose from.
author: 무냐무냥

title: 정말 깔끔하고 좋습니다!
body: 안녕하세요 Habitkit 한국인 유저입니다. 정말 무료에서도 기능이 정말 많고 UIUX도 깔끔하고 너무 좋은 것 같습니다👍
author: depaier

title: Intuitive and simple
body: Wanted an app with clear and simple visuals and here it is! I can see the progress in a small grid and it is so satisfying.
author: 암밀람암젬

title: No sign up needed, beautiful UI
body: UI is great and customisable. No sign up needed and treats your personal data with respect, unlike apps like habitat which requires you to email them to delete your personal data. Although I wish it had a better “share with friends” feature. HabitShare is the only app that has a decent accountability partner feature (notifs when friend checks in, can directly see friend’s log), that despite being the simplest app out here has me going back to it. This app’s “sharing” feature is basically a screenshot export.
author: Sivath
